scope: C-006 daily-rules-v1 integer scoring, deterministic candidates, RuleFacts, ControlledExpressionPlanV1 and limited choice trace

T-C006-RULES-001.selector: C-006 daily-rules-v1 golden vectors and integer/catalog properties
assertions: all five complete daily golden cases and two focused rule cases are recomputed from the Accepted S-11 fixture
all 180 legal mood-energy-sleep combinations terminate with one to three canonical action candidates and pass RuleFactsSchema
every known adjacent ordinal increase is monotonic across all five integer scores
profile, relationship, context, catalog storage order and an unconsumed namespace do not perturb RuleFacts or existing choices
duplicate and empty catalogs plus score-band mismatch fail with stable deterministic codes

T-C006-BINDING-001.selector: C-006 daily snapshot, manifest and root-seed bindings
assertions: strict snapshot unknown, missing, invalid enum, context date, style and unregistered product inputs fail closed
snapshot version, result binding, manifest fingerprint/closure and root seed mismatch return stable terminal codes
ControlledExpressionPlanV1 is frozen, keeps context slots empty and contains no raw score, root seed, manifest fingerprint or choice trace
the public choice trace contains only namespace, candidate count, counter, index and hashed state
